# Applied to kyverno-policy-selftest, a namespace carrying NO Pod Security
# Admission labels. That is the whole point of this file: in hsm-pki-dev,
# PSA refuses the same manifest first, so a refusal there is evidence about
# PSA and none at all about Kyverno. Here PSA is not watching, so the only
# thing that can have said no is the policy.
#
# Compare with insecure-pod.rejected.txt, which is PSA refusing it.
#
# Note what this does NOT show: the other eight rules. This manifest breaks
# every rule at once and admission reports the first. Nor does it show the
# two shapes that matter most, because neither is expressible as a pod
# manifest that is obviously insecure -- a container quietly overriding a
# hardened pod's securityContext, and a privileged container attached to an
# already-running pod through the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource.
# Both were live bypasses of this policy until they were measured. All of
# it is covered by deploy/k8s/policy/policy-selftest.py, nineteen cases.
